description.value: The Creston Valley Visitor Centre is operated by the Creston Valley Tourism Society and serves as the official tourism information hub for the Kootenay region's 'hidden gem'. Staff can assist visitors with area maps, local recommendations, event listings, and up-to-date travel advisories including border crossings, ferry schedules, and road conditions. For touring cyclists passing through the southern Kootenays, it is a natural stop for regional trip-planning resources and insider knowledge of the valley.
